result.brief: 提出 RegisterWAM，在世界模型表征中引入可学习非空间 register 并用观测流匹配监督抑制空间离群点，将动作相关信息集中到 register 以条件化机器人动作。
result.reason: Analyzes and reorganizes action-relevant information in generative visual world-model representations (registers, outlier suppression), a representation contribution for action-conditioned world models.
